title: Patch: a dungeon run shows your deck, relics, blessings, curses and seed between fights, and a past run's curses by name
thread:
**Issue #3501 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #3501: Patch: a dungeon run shows your deck, relics, blessings, curses and seed between fights, and a past run's curses by name Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means Between fights, the dungeon's top bar shows only your health, coins and tickets, how many cards your deck holds, and your relics' names. There is no way to: - look at the deck you have built; - read what a relic does; - see the blessings and curses you carry; - see the run's seed, which you would share so a friend can play the same run. On the dungeon stats page, a past run's curses show as internal names such as "temp-curse-1". Once this is built, a "Your run" button on the map opens all of that in one panel, the seed shows on the run-over screen, and curses show their names everywhere. ## Why - **The HUD shows little.** `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx:36-76` shows HP, Coins, Tickets, `Deck: {run.deck.length}`, each relic's name and level, and the score. Nothing else of the run is shown. - **Curses never appear during a fight.** The fight tray (`apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx:249-254`) shows relics and blessings. - **The deck is seen only in passing.** Its faces appear only on the shop, campfire and extraction screens. - **Past curses print as ids.** `apps/web/src/dungeon/stats/DungeonStats.tsx:228-229` renders each of a record's curses as `t(curse)`. The record holds ids such as `temp-curse-1` (`crates/run/src/placeholder.json:738`), and no translation exists for them, so the id is printed. - **Seeds are meant to be shared.** §15.2 (`spec/15-dungeon-run.md:87`): "Seeds can be shared and typed in." No screen shows a run's seed during or after the run. ## Proposal - **A "Your run" button in the HUD** opens the shared `Dialog` (`apps/web/src/game/Dialog.tsx`). It lists: - the deck, as `RunCardFace`s with their Radiant and buff marks, in a compact grid; - the relics and blessings, with their text; - the curses, with name and text from the run's content; - the seed, with a copy button. - **`RunOverScreen` shows the seed.** - **`DungeonStats` shows curse names** from the content. An id the content no longer has falls back to the id. - **Strings** are added to `zh-CN.json`. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx` and its test, plus a panel component beside it - `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunOverScreen.tsx` - `apps/web/src/dungeon/stats/DungeonStats.tsx` and its test - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` - spec §15.5 and §15.10, if they list what the screens show ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `RunScreen.test.tsx`: the panel lists every deck card with its Radiant and buff marks, each relic, blessing and curse with its text, and the seed. - [ ] The panel takes focus and closes on Escape, as the shared Dialog does. - [ ] `RunOverScreen` shows the run's seed. - [ ] `DungeonStats.test.tsx`: a record's curses show by name, not by id. - [ ] At phone width the panel scrolls and nothing overflows sideways. ## Size and risks Small to medium: about 7 files in `apps/web`. Difficulty medium. - A deck of 40 or more cards on a phone needs the compact layout. - It reuses existing faces and passive presentation, so no new art. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42679612003)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Add a **Your run** button to the dungeon run's top bar. It opens the shared `Dialog` listing: - the deck, as a compact grid of `RunCardFace`s with Radiant and Buffs marks; - the relics and blessings, with name, level and text; - the curses, with name, points and text; - the seed, with a copy button. `RunOverScreen` shows the seed. `DungeonStats` shows a past run's curses by name from the run's content, and an id the content lacks stays as the id. Every new string goes into `zh-CN.json`. At phone width the panel scrolls and nothing overflows sideways. ## Files to touch | Path | Kind | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunPanel.tsx` | new | `RunPanel` (the HUD button and its `Dialog`) and `SeedRow` (copy) | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/run-panel.css` | new | the panel's layout, design tokens only | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx` | change | `RunHud` renders ``; doc comment | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunDisplay.tsx` | change | add `curseName` and `CurseChoice` | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunOverScreen.tsx` | change | seed line; header comment | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/run.css` | change | `.dungeon-run-end__seed` | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/testids.ts` | change | panel and seed ids | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts` | change | `export` the existing `contentOf` | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/stats/DungeonStats.tsx` | change | curses by name | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | four keys | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx` | change | content fixture, panel, seed and CSS tests | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/stats/DungeonStats.test.tsx` | change | `contentOf` in the store mock, curse-name test | | `spec/15-dungeon-run.md` | change | one short paragraph each in §15.5 and §15.10 | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | add the Your run panel to the Dialog users' list (about line 141) | Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, any `crates/`, `apps/web/src/wire/` or `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/`. Governing text: spec §15.2 (seeds are shared), §15.5, §15.9 and §15.10, and CLAUDE.md rules 7 (presentation only) and 9. No ruling is needed because no rules decision is made. Cite no `R` in new code or comments, because `spec check` fails on an unknown one. ## Steps 1. **`store.ts`.** Change `function contentOf()` (about line 222) to `export function contentOf()`. Add the doc line "The compiled-in content, built once; the stats page names a past run's curses from it." Nothing else changes. 2. **`RunDisplay.tsx`.** - Add `RunCurseDef` to the `import type { … } from "@jackioh/run"` line. - After `passiveName`, add: ```ts function curseDef(content: RunContent, id: string): RunCurseDef | undefined { return content.curses.find((curse) => curse.id === id); } /** A curse's name, translated, falling back to its id: a record may name one the content dropped. */ export function curseName(content: RunContent, id: string): string { const def = curseDef(content, id); return def === undefined ? id : t(def.name); } ``` - After `PassiveChoice`, add `export function CurseChoice({ id, content }: { id: string; content: RunContent }): ReactElement`. - It copies `PassiveChoice`'s shape: the outer ``. - An unknown id returns `{id}`. - Otherwise it renders `{t(def.name)}`, then `{t("Points: {points}", { points: String(def.points) })}`, then `{t(def.text)}`. - "Points: {points}" already exists in `zh-CN.json`. 3. **`testids.ts`.** Add to `dungeonMapTestid`, each with a one-line doc comment as the file does: - `yourRun: "dungeon-run-your-run"` - `panel: "dungeon-run-panel"` - `panelClose: "dungeon-run-panel-close"` - `panelSeed: "dungeon-run-panel-seed"` - `panelSeedCopy: "dungeon-run-panel-seed-copy"` - `panelDeck: "dungeon-run-panel-deck"` - `panelCard: (index: number): string => \`dungeon-run-panel-card-${String(index)}\`` - `panelArtifacts`, `panelBlessings` and `panelCurses`: the containers, `"dungeon-run-panel-artifacts"` and so on. - `panelArtifact(index)`, `panelBlessing(index)` and `panelCurse(index)`: the items, `dungeon-run-panel-artifact-${index}` and so on. - `endSeed: "dungeon-run-end-seed"` 4. **`zh-CN.json`.** Insert these four lines after the `"Curse points: {points}": "诅咒点数：{points}",` line. The file is flat JSON with no trailing comma issue there. - `"Your run": "你的探险",` - `"Blessings": "祝福",` - `"No blessings": "没有祝福",` - `"Copy seed": "复制种子",` Reused keys that already exist: `Deck`, `Relics`, `Curses`, `Seed`, `Seed: {seed}`, `Copied`, `No relics`, `No curses`, `No cards yet.`, `Level {level}`, `Points: {points}`, `Buffs: {count}`. Every English string is sentence case, as `writing.test.ts` requires. 5. **`run-panel.css` (new).** Tokens only, as `dungeon-stats.css`'s `.dungeon-stats__dialog` does. No raw px in a gap, padding or margin, no colors, no radii or shadows of its own, and no `@media` (a new query would need a `breakpoints.test.ts` entry). At 360 px the deck is 3 columns. Add a header comment naming #3501. 6. **`RunPanel.tsx` (new).** The header comment says: the panel is presentation only (rule 7), and `run.css` (loaded by `RunScreen`) supplies the card and passive classes it reuses. - Imports: `useRef`, `useState`, `ReactElement` from `react`; `RunContent` and `RunState` from `@jackioh/run`; `Dialog` from `../../game/Dialog.tsx`; `t` from `../../i18n/i18n.ts`; `attempt` from `../../net/errors.ts`; `dungeonMapTestid` from `./testids.ts`; `CurseChoice`, `PassiveChoice` and `RunCardFace` from `./RunDisplay.tsx`; and `"./run-panel.css"`. - `export function RunPanel({ run, content }: { run: RunState; content: RunContent }): ReactElement` holds `const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)` and `const opener = useRef(null)`. - `const close = (): void => { setOpen(false); opener.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }`. Focusing the opener explicitly matters because a click does not focus a button in Safari. - It returns a fragment. The button is ``. - When `open` it also renders ``. Assert the sheet contains: - `width: min(720px, 100%)`; - `overflow-x: hidden`; - `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(96px, 1fr))`; - no `max-height`, because the scrim scrolls the panel. **`apps/web/src/dungeon/stats/DungeonStats.test.tsx`** - Add a hoisted `const content = vi.hoisted(() => ({ curses: [{ id: "heavy-hands", name: "Heavy Hands", text: "Enemies start each fight with 5 more health.", points: 2 }] }))`. - Add to the `vi.mock("../store.ts", …)` factory: `contentOf: () => ({ pool: [], starterAccess: [], enemies: [], passives: [], events: [], curses: content.curses })`. - Inside `describe("B32 …")`, add **`#3501 a record's curses show by name from the content, and an id the content lacks shows as the id`**: - Set `historyPlan.records = [recordFixture({ seed: "EEEEEE", curses: ["heavy-hands", "gone-curse"] })]` and render. - Click `entryAt("deepest", 0)`. - `within(screen.getByTestId(dungeonStatsTestid.detailCurses))` has text "Heavy Hands" and "gone-curse". - It does not have text "heavy-hands". - The existing curse ids (`ember-oath`, `iron-rations`) are not in the content, so `expectRunDetails` still passes through the fallback. **Commands** `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg` is absent, so use `pnpm --dir apps/web test `, whose `pretest` builds the WebAssembly module. - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx src/dungeon/stats/DungeonStats.test.tsx` - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts src/writing.test.ts src/wording.test.ts src/spacing.test.ts src/typescale.test.ts src/surfaces.test.ts src/palette.test.ts src/buttons.test.ts src/dialogs.test.ts src/breakpoints.test.ts src/dungeon` - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/dungeon` - `cargo jackioh spec check` Optional: `ui-walkthrough` at a 360 px width of `/dungeon`, opening the panel with a 40-card deck, to confirm the 3-column grid and no sideways scroll. jsdom cannot lay it out, so step 5's CSS test is the automated proof. ## Done when - [ ] A **Your run** button is in the HUD on every phase except fights, and opens a `Dialog` with the seed, the deck (Radiant and Buffs marks), relics, blessings and curses, each with its text. - [ ] The seed copies, and a refused clipboard changes nothing. - [ ] The ✕ takes focus, Escape closes the panel, and focus returns to the button. - [ ] `RunOverScreen` shows "Seed: …". - [ ] `DungeonStats` shows curses by name, with the id as fallback. - [ ] The four new keys are in `zh-CN.json`, and `i18n`, `writing` and `wording` pass. - [ ] The phone-width CSS holds and no new raw spacing, radius or color is added (`spacing`, `surfaces`, `palette`, `buttons` tests green). - [ ] The tests of both files and the broader web tests above pass, as do typecheck, eslint and `cargo jackioh spec check`. - [ ] `cargo fmt --check` is clean (no Rust changed), and the harness's web test run is green. - [ ] The decisions below are recorded in the pull request. ## Risks - **Stats mock.** `DungeonStats.test.tsx` mocks `../store.ts` entirely, so without `contentOf` in the factory vitest throws "no export defined". Step 11 adds it. - **Frozen CSS counts.** `spacing.test.ts` and `surfaces.test.ts` freeze raw-length counts per sheet, and `run.css` is one of them. Keeping the panel in the new sheet with tokens, and adding only `margin: 0` to `run.css`, avoids breaking them. - **i18n literals.** `t("…")` literals must exist in `zh-CN.json` (the `i18n` test), and keys with `{token}` must keep the same tokens in the Chinese. - **Emoji.** `dungeon/noEmoji.test.ts` bans emoji under `dungeon/`, so use no glyph in the button. - **Text close buttons.** `dialogs.test.ts` bans a text "Close" button, so the ✕ is the only close. - **Engine not loaded.** `contentOf()` throws if the engine is not loaded. The stats route is inside `EngineGate` and tests load it in `test/setup.ts`, so this is safe. - **No rule enforcement.** The panel reads `run` and `content` and sends nothing to the run (rule 7). ## Open questions None blocks the build. Decisions the builder records: - **Fight tray.** The issue's "Why" says curses never show in a fight, but its proposal and "Where it lands" do not touch the fight tray, so `fight/` stays unchanged. A person may want curses in the tray later. - **Seed first in the panel.** The issue lists it last, but it goes first so a long deck does not push it out of view on a phone. - **Curse names on the stats page.** They come from the current compiled content, not from the content the run was played on, because the record stores only ids. A dropped id shows as the id. - **`contentOf` is exported and called inside `RunDetails`.** The alternative was a second `runContent()` parse through the wasm bindings, which would make the test depend on the placeholder curses that the designer's content will replace. - **Seed on the run-over screen is plain text.** There is no copy button there, because the HUD's panel is present on that screen. --- Comment by @jgoetzmann at 2026-11-09T19:00:37Z: approve ````
